Appointments.Import.Title: Your diary from a file
Appointments.Import.Intro: Bring the coming weeks of your old system's diary over in one go. Save the list of visits as CSV and upload it here. Before anything changes, you will see what would be added, and what would not and why.
Appointments.Import.Order.Clients: First, your clients from a file
Appointments.Import.Order.Services: Then your price list from a file
Appointments.Import.FileHint: Up to {0} visits from today on, and {1} MB. History in the file is left out.
Appointments.Import.Columns.Title: What the file looks like
Appointments.Import.Columns.Lead: The first row names the columns, in any order. Needed: the date and the start time (or both in one column), the service, and the client's name, phone or email. Also read: the end time or the length, the person, the price and the status.
Appointments.Import.Columns.Dates: Dates are read day first, as 20/11/2026 or 20.11.2026, or as 2026-11-20. A file with dates written month first is refused.
Appointments.Import.Rules.Future: Only visits from now on are brought over. Earlier visits, and visits the old system marks cancelled, are left out.
Appointments.Import.Rules.Match: Each visit is matched to a client, a service and a person you already have here, by phone, email or name. Nothing new is created.
Appointments.Import.Rules.Silent: Clients get no message when their visits are brought over: the old system confirmed them. From now on they get our reminders, as for any visit.
Appointments.Import.Rules.OldSystem: Stop online booking in the old system before you make the last file. Keep its reminders on until the time the next page gives you.
Appointments.Import.Rules.Notes: Notes are not brought over: they can hold health details.
Appointments.Import.Expired: The preview has expired. Upload the file again.
Appointments.Import.Clash: Someone booked a visit into one of the file's times while you were checking it. Nothing was added. Upload the file again to see it against the diary as it is now.
Appointments.Import.Undo.Title: Take a file out of the diary
Appointments.Import.Undo.Lead: A file read in by mistake can be taken out again. A visit the desk has touched since - moved, marked or taken money for - stays with its history, and reading the same file in again brings the removed visits back.
Appointments.Import.Undo.None: No file has been read into the diary yet.
Appointments.Import.Undo.Untouched: Still exactly as the file left them: {0}.
Appointments.Import.Undo.Done: The file is out of the diary: {0}, {1} kept.
Appointments.Import.Undo.Link: Take a file out of the diary

Appointments.Import.Error.NotText: The file is not a text CSV file. Save the list as CSV, not as a spreadsheet.
Appointments.Import.Error.MonthFirst: The dates in this file are written month first, as 11/20/2026. Change the date column to day first (20/11/2026) or to 2026-11-20 in your spreadsheet, save it as CSV and upload it again.

Appointments.Import.Error.MissingColumns: We could not find a column for: {0}. Rename the headings in your spreadsheet, for example "Date", "Start time", "Service" and "Client". Columns found: {1}
